messages:
fiona: Opening a tiny PR to add a short cross-language example (JS + Python) for Optimize that shows batching + prefix cache and a compact quant profile. Also fixing one broken anchor under /optimize/quantization. Tagging @harry for snippet wording and @kevin for link redirects.
harry: Please paste the JS and Python snippets here so I can verify naming and small wording nits. Keep each example 6 lines max for docs readability.
fiona: JS draft:
```js
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
await c.generate({ model: 'redwood/mini-v1', input: 'TL;DR this paragraph', batching: { max_batch_tokens: 800 }, cache: { mode: 'prefix' }, quant_profile: 'q4_0_small' });
```
Python draft:
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
print(c.generate(model='redwood/mini-v1', input='TL;DR this paragraph', batching={'max_batch_tokens':800}, cache={'mode':'prefix'}, quant_profile='q4_0_small').text)
```
kevin: CI linkchecker flagged `/optimize/old-quant` anchor in main. I'll add a redirect to `/optimize/quantization/profiles` in the PR and grep for other hits.
anya: Add a one-line note under the snippet: "Use smaller max_batch_tokens for latency-sensitive paths; increase for throughput." Also include a tiny smoke test (2 prompts, check non-empty).
fiona: PR created and linkcheck shows redirect applied. Docs-bot: PR opened by fiona: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1401> (docs: optimize - crosslang snippets + quant redirect)
docs-bot: staging deploy completed: <https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize>
kevin: Merged after one approval and smoke tests passed. Thanks all.
